reviews.text:
Amazing sounds and artwork of the great outdoors. The sounds in this app are brilliant! I’ve used it before to help me get to sleep while I was on vacation and couldn’t bring my fan with me. I always like to have a little bit of ambient noise when I’m falling asleep and this does the trick perfectly! The new version has more sounds which I got since I already upgraded on Apple TV. My favorite soundscapes are Ocean, Rain, and Campfire. The Cave one is really fun too.

One recommendation I’d like to make would be for there to be more sounds. I know the app just added new sounds but I’d like to see even more in the future. There is already a rain sound but perhaps a light rain would be a nice addition. Something like a quick Spring shower and maybe even mixed in with a few birds. I’m loving all of the new tracks and I can tell the older ones have been enhanced too. Keep up the great work and I’ll be listening for whatever comes next!

Very, extremely awesome!. I was immediately intrigued when I heard about Nature Soundscapes because relaxation apps are kinda my thing. I used to practically collect them, so I wanted to download it right away, before knowing too much about it. And boy! Am I ever glad I did! This app is a jewel! It's drop dead simple to use, which is great when you're in a hurry to calm down, and many sincere thanks to the developer for adding VoiceOver support. The app's accessibility is flawless in my book. I have no complaints there. And the sound samples! OMG! I didn't think I would be all that impressed at first, because the ocean and rain sounds very clearly come from The sound effects collection for iMovie. I can tell because I'm a Mac user. But, The other three free sounds are so fantastic! That calm White noise sound is perfect for noise masking, but at the same time, it's so soft and gentle. The stream sound is nothing short of musical, and the wilderness sound reminds me of a cartoon fairyland, or country paradise. Pretty generous offering for five free sounds, not because of the quantity, but rather the quality. They're absolutely wonderful. I also really love the control center support. Excellent idea, and it works perfectly. The only real problem I have with the app is that the sleep timer causes the sound to abruptly cut off when it ends. I don't like that very much, so maybe a fade out option would be nice. On the whole, this is a really fantastic app. It's perfect for anyone who is into nature sounds, and looking for a simple, uncomplicated way to calm down or get sleep in a crunch. Congratulations to the developer on a job well done.
